ee_t4_osorio.name: EE-T4 Osório
ee_t4_osorio.authority: A fictional development (concept facet): the owner asked on 2026-10-30 for "a super modernized hypotehtical version a tier 9 and a tier 10" and Main ruled the same day (DECISIONS): EE-T4 Osório, tier X, continuing Engesa's numbering as the Challenger 1's fictional FV4030/5 and /6 continue Vickers'. No such vehicle was built; the base is the surviving P.2, whose photographs these are, under the EE-T3's kit heavier and full length, a hard-kill active protection system (four radar panels, two launchers), laser-warning heads, slat armour over the rear plate with two 200 L fuel drums behind it (the owner, 2026-10-31) and a 130 mm L/51.
ee_t4_osorio.envelopeBasis: Width, length and tallest are the as-built envelope of the shared Osório build (profiles/osorio.ts, mark t4): the P.2's 7.13 m hull and 2.37 m roof, the kit's widths over the composite skirt modules (3.51 m), the 6.6 m gun forward (12.425 m with its muzzle at hull z 7.85, including the rear slat armour and the two fuel drums behind it), the tallest the turret's whips (Box3 of the build at both qualities).
